name: DS Cluster S10b: Downsample All Aggregation Methods
description: Tests: all NumericDownsampleAgg variants — last, first, mean, sum, min, max, median, std.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S10b: All Downsample Aggregation Methods
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
rets = returns()(close)

# === ALL how= VARIANTS ===
w_last = downsample(target_timeframe=1W, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(close)
w_first = downsample(target_timeframe=1W, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.first)(close)
w_mean = downsample(target_timeframe=1W, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.mean)(close)
w_sum = downsample(target_timeframe=1W, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.sum)(rets)
w_min = downsample(target_timeframe=1W, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.min)(close)
w_max = downsample(target_timeframe=1W, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.max)(close)
# NOTE: NumericDownsampleAgg.median NOT IMPLEMENTED (BUG-11: hash_median missing)
# w_median = downsample(target_timeframe=1W, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.median)(close)
w_std = downsample(target_timeframe=1W, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.std)(rets)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Weekly: Last vs First vs Mean",
    category="Downsample",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Last", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="First", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Mean", color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(w_last, w_first, w_mean))

xy_lines(
    title="Weekly: Min vs Max vs Median",
    category="Downsample",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Min", color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Max", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Sum", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(w_min, w_max, w_sum))

histogram(category="Downsample", title="Weekly Return Std", bins=20)(w_std)
